events.verdict: Finney-Smith (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Lillard's (POR) drive to the basket.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Lillard (POR) loses control of the ball during his drive and the ball goes out of bounds.
Harkless (POR) places a hand/arm to the front of Doncic (DAL) during the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Powell (DAL) establishes himself in a legal position in the path of Harkless (POR) and absorbs the contact.
LAR shows Harkless (POR) makes some contact with Doncic's (DAL) side during the pick but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Harkless (POR) makes contact to the arm of Doncic (DAL) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
McCollum (POR) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Powell (DAL) and gives him room to avoid contact.

CNC RATR and RHH shows that Kleber (DAL) plants and jumps vertically with his arms extended up and down. L-Slash shows that after contact with Lillard (POR), Kleber's arms come down slightly, but do not make contact with Lillard.
Collins (POR) makes hand on ball contact and gets tied up with Doncic (DAL) during the rebound. A correct jump ball is called.
Layman (POR) makes some contact with Doncic's (DAL) arm during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
RATR shows that Hardaway Jr. (DAL) maintains a legal forearm to McCullum's (POR) side that doesn't affect his SQBR on the drive.
Collins (POR) briefly clamps Doncic's (DAL) arm during the rebound but does not affect his ability to secure the missed shot.
Powell (DAL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Hood (POR) and does not deliver contact.
Powell (MAL) makes some contact with Collins (POR) during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.

RATR and RHH show that when Lillard (POR) changes direction, he catches Finney-Smith's (DAL) hand/arm and moves through the contact. The contact does not affect his SQBR. However, Finney-Smith reaches forward and makes contact to Lillard's front.

Kleber (DAL) initially jumps when defending Lillard's (POR) driving shot attempt with his arms up vertically, but then re-reaches and makes contact with his arm, affecting his shot and follow-through.

Lillard (POR) makes some contact to Kleber's (DAL) shoulder after he secures the rebound but he does not dislodge him from his obtained position.
